scenarios.title: Launch packaged Quirky with fresh HOME/QUIRKY_HOME and a run-owned fake Codex CLI exposing an allowlisted synthetic authorize URL. Do not authenticate or read a real credential. Cancel the owned pending login. Preserve m3-accounts AC6-AC7's historical target=_blank failure report; this is the repaired public-system-opener rerun.

Exercise Focus pane and lineage jump in the real window (same session, no process spawn), Open transcript and Finder reveal/Open working directory. Never reveal real provider paths. Browser feedback is not native focus/Finder proof; keep historical m3 native reports unchanged.

With fresh HOME/QUIRKY_HOME, run-owned valid PNG and fake supported terminal agent, enable Terminal dock, type an unsent draft, use Attach and the real macOS Open panel to select the created PNG, verify the named chip and unchanged text, remove only that chip and confirm original PNG bytes remain.
